_comment: English body for feishu-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by Feishu’s intelligent partner capabilities; the model and available features vary by tenant edition, region and administrator settings.
axes.runtime: Runs in Feishu’s cloud, with entry points in messages, docs, meetings, calendar and the knowledge base; the local client only handles interaction.
axes.local_files: Can read documents, messages, meetings and calendar content the tenant is authorised to access; local files must be uploaded to Feishu.
axes.background: Meeting notes, message summaries and document tasks are triggered in their own surfaces; there is no cross-tenant general background agent.
axes.tools: Integrated with Feishu docs, sheets, Base, meetings, calendar, approvals and bots; extensible through the open platform.
axes.context: Context comes from content the tenant can access plus the current conversation; cross-department retrieval is limited by permissions and knowledge-base scope.
axes.permissions: Tenant admins control features, data scope and logs; commercial use and data residency follow the Feishu contract.
axes.fit: Fits: meeting notes, document collaboration and message summaries for teams already working in Feishu. Does not fit: cross-company, cross-platform unified retrieval.

runs: This site has not completed measured task runs for this entry. We checked the official product, help and terms pages and recorded capabilities, data paths and known limits.
